notes: Check my setup, in Help or the wrench in the left bar. It runs through everything that has to be true for a teleport to work and tells you in plain words which part is broken, with a button where UseAlibi can repair it for you. Signing in opened a file browser instead of a web browser on some PCs, and no longer does. Switching to USB and failing used to leave the switch reading USB while the app was on Wi-Fi; it now switches back and reconnects. Connecting over Wi-Fi tells you your iPhone shows no location in Find My until you pick one, instead of leaving you to wonder. Setup now says to unlock your iPhone and use a data cable. Restarting warns you first and comes back reliably. On your phone, a teleport made in the home-screen app now shows correctly when you switch back to the browser. UseAlibi also records which iPhone and app version you are running, and whether teleports are working, so support can see what you have instead of asking. It does not send your serial number, device ID, network addresses, or anywhere you have been.
